Recording rights
Rule 1 — recording-specific public-domain release: PD-USGov (US-law basis). Documented

Commons expressly applies PD-USGov to the recording or official federal-government performance, not only to the composition. Under 17 U.S.C. § 105(a), official US Government works are not protected by US copyright. This is rule 1’s recording-specific public-domain release route, not rule 2’s publication-date route; it does not establish worldwide public-domain status. Commons separately specifies CC BY 3.0 for Pratt’s performance; the speculative PD-release suggestion is not needed.
